entries.zh: 历史记录中有一份说明理由令状。

entries.en: The image displays the scleral veins in blue.
entries.zh: 图像用蓝色显示了巩膜静脉。

entries.en: The model exposes part of the sclerotic coat.
entries.zh: 模型露出了部分巩膜。

entries.en: The grower reported sclerotium rot in the crop.
entries.zh: 种植者报告作物出现了菌核腐烂病。

entries.en: The stoneworker repaired the damaged scoinson arch.
entries.zh: 石匠修复了受损的对角斜拱。

entries.en: The restoration team examined the sconcheon arch carefully.
entries.zh: 修复团队仔细检查了墙拱。

entries.en: He cleaned the pan with a scouring pad.
entries.zh: 他用擦洗片清洁了平底锅。

entries.en: She served scrambled eggs on warm toast.
entries.zh: 她把炒鸡蛋盛在热吐司上端来。

entries.en: The carpenter marked the wood with a scratch awl.
entries.zh: 木匠用划针在木头上做了标记。
